name: cgc-annotator
description: Quartz 5 plugin that shows annotations written with Obsidian's Annotator plugin, and mirrors their source documents. See CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/.
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copy, never bundled into the plugin or installed here: the page body's vnodes must be the host's. The Viewer's browser bundle carries a copy of it, built from the same install.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: build.mjs bundles dist/, the Viewer's browser chunks and its stylesheet, whose PDF.js text layer PostCSS prefixes into the Viewer's block, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check checks it all against ADR-0003. Our libraries are `file:` specs on main, which a release commit rewrites to the release's published version (ADR-0005). pdfjs-dist is pinned exactly: PDF.js throws if its API and worker differ, and the text-layer CSS is copied from this version.
